title: 香港禁片《消失的檔案》揭露四大核心內幕
summary: Eric Chau 臉書 2026-11-8 香港禁片《消失的檔案》（Vanished Archives）是由香港資深傳媒人羅恩惠執導、歷時四年苦心搜集資料而完成的紀錄片。 這部影片之所以命名為「消失的檔案」，是因為導演當初在香港歷史檔案館搜集「六七暴動」的官方影像紀錄時，驚覺原應長達數百小時的歷史片段，在香港竟然只剩下殘缺不全的21秒。 為了尋回被刻意或無意抹去的歷史真相，羅恩惠遠赴英國國家檔案館翻查解密文件，並親自訪問了大量當年的親歷者。這部紀錄片最終揭露了多項關於196
content: Eric Chau   臉書  2026-11-8 香港禁片《消失的檔案》（Vanished Archives）是由香港資深傳媒人羅恩惠執導、歷時四年苦心搜集資料而完成的紀錄片。 這部影片之所以命名為「消失的檔案」，是因為導演當初在香港歷史檔案館搜集「六七暴動」的官方影像紀錄時，驚覺原應長達數百小時的歷史片段，在香港竟然只剩下殘缺不全的21秒。 為了尋回被刻意或無意抹去的歷史真相，羅恩惠遠赴英國國家檔案館翻查解密文件，並親自訪問了大量當年的親歷者。這部紀錄片最終揭露了多項關於1967年香港暴動事件、極具震撼力的內幕消息與歷史黑幕： 紀錄片揭露的四大核心內幕 1. 核心絕密文獻：《吳荻舟日記》與《67筆記》 影片最關鍵的歷史突破，是找到了當年國務院外事辦公室港澳組副組長吳荻舟的私人筆記與檢討材料。 中央高層直接介入： 過去有說法指六七暴動純屬香港左派造反派（如新華社香港分社）自導自演的盲動。但《67筆記》證實，北京中央政府對香港暴亂的每一個細節其實一直知情，甚至不時發出具體指示。 截獲「真槍實彈」： 筆記記載，當時有左派激進分子試圖從內地運送8,400把滅火刀（砍刀）到香港發動武裝暴動。這批物資最終被吳荻舟及時攔截，他因此在文革中遭到迫害。這證實當時暴動確實有演變成全面血腥武裝衝突的奪權計畫。 2. 揭開「少年犯」與「炸彈隊」的真實代價 六七暴動後期發展成無差別的恐怖主義炸彈襲擊，街道上到處都是俗稱「菠蘿」的土製炸彈。 被煽動的愛國學生： 影片訪問了多位當年的左派學校學生（如香島中學、培僑中學等）。他們在文革狂熱的政治宣傳下被煽動組織「炸彈隊」，抱著「反英抗暴」的愛國熱忱上街投擲炸彈、派發傳單。 被拋棄的犧牲品： 這些年輕人在入獄後遭到港英政府的嚴刑拷打，甚至被秘密政治部審訊。然而，當暴動被周恩來叫停、事件平息後，中共高層為了重回外交正軌，迅速與這些基層左派「割席」。這些留有案底的年輕人被港英政府與中共雙方拋棄，政治狂熱退去後，換來的是大半生的坎坷與幻滅。 3. 港共地下黨的權力鬥爭與盲動 紀錄片揭示，這場暴動本質上是中國文化大革命在香港的外延與投影。當時新華社香港分社（實際上的港共地下黨組織）社長梁威林、副社長祁烽等人，為迎合內地文革「造反有理」的風潮，並在外交部奪權鬥爭中表態，不惜在香港無限放大勞資糾紛（新蒲崗人造花廠事件），刻意將其升級為流血政治對抗。 4. 歷史敘事權的爭奪與「改寫」 這部影片最深遠的內幕，莫過於揭露了官方對歷史記憶的系統性清洗。 港英政府的處理： 六七暴動結束後，英國政府將大量極度敏感的政治部（Political Department）檔案、港共滲透名單及審訊紀錄運回英國本土，或直接銷毀，導致香港本地檔案館出現巨大斷層。 特區政府的洗白： 導演指出，近年來特區政府及建制陣營正試圖「重塑」這段歷史，淡化無差別炸彈襲擊對平民造成的傷害，將其重新包裝成「反殖民統治的愛國正義抗爭」。《消失的檔案》則透過血淋淋的受害者證詞（如商業電台林彬被活活燒死、北角小姊弟被炸彈炸死的家屬訪問），還原了這場運動曾演變成無差別恐怖襲擊的史實。 影片的遭遇與社會餘波 由於影片赤裸裸地曝光了中共與港共組織在歷史上的操弄與滲透，《消失的檔案》在2017年完成後遭遇了極大的政治壓力： 官方及商業電影院拒絕放映，香港國際電影節亦以「缺乏藝術性」為由將其拒之門外。 儘管遭受封殺，導演依然在香港社區、學校及海外（美、加、台）進行了數百場獨立放映，引發極大反響，被歷史學者視為還原香港當代史最重要的民間口述紀錄片。 歷史猶如一面鏡子，五十年前內地與香港的政治糾葛，與今日香港的政治變遷有著絲絲入扣的歷史脈絡。羅恩惠導演曾表示，拍攝這部影片不為挑起仇恨，而是為了「守護香港記憶，不讓真相在掌權者的橡皮擦下消失」。

title: Our Best Look Yet at China’s GJ-11 UCAV
zh_title: 我们对中国 GJ-11 无人战斗机的最佳观察
summary: 在解放军空军成立 77 周年之前发布的新官方镜头揭示了 GJ-11 设计和配置的更多细节。中国于 2026 年 11 月 9 日发布了 GJ-11“利剑”无人机 (UCAV) 的新官方视频，揭示了其设计和配置的更多特点。这一发布是在 11 月 11 日中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 成立 77 周年纪念日的前两天发布的。去年同一天，PLAAF 发布了首个视频，显示 GJ-11 与一架 J-20 和一架 J-16D 电子战机编队飞行
content:
在解放军空军成立 77 周年之前发布的新官方镜头揭示了 GJ-11 设计和配置的更多细节。中国于 2026 年 11 月 9 日发布了 GJ-11“利剑”无人机 (UCAV) 的新官方视频，揭示了其设计和配置的更多特点。这一发布是在 11 月 11 日中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 成立 77 周年纪念日的前两天发布的。去年同一天，PLAAF 发布了首个视频，显示 GJ-11 与一架 J-20 和一架 J-16D 电子战 (EW) 飞机编队飞行。 GJ-11 通常被认为与美国协同作战飞机 (CCA) 的作用相当。 #PLAAF GJ-11 出现在空军宣传视频中。 https://t.co/hPS8qG5jWv — Iron Lady (@nuwangzi) 2026 年 11 月 9 日 GJ-11 忠诚僚机的新镜头最新的视觉效果可以更仔细地观察 GJ-11 的机身和表面光洁度，尽管其涂层的成分无法仅从镜头中确定。 《环球时报》援引中国军事专家宋忠平的话说，该飞机使用雷达吸收材料（RAM）涂层来减小雷达截面积。 GJ-11 似乎是一种相对高端、专注于隐形的 UCAV，而不是一种成本较低、可能易磨损的平台。
在这方面，它可能更类似于洛克希德·马丁公司与 Vectis 合作开发的高性能飞机类型，而不是美国空军第一个增量中追求的更注重负担能力的 CCA 概念，例如 FQ-42A 复仇和 FQ-44A 狂怒。 GJ-11 离开机库。 |资料来源：解放军空军 与 2025 年 11 月的周年纪念影片相比，新镜头更近距离地展示了 GJ-11，该影片显示无人战斗机与一架 J-20 和一架 J-16D 编队飞行。 2025 年 10 月发布的卫星图像已经表明存在多个机身，显示西藏日喀则空军基地有三架 GJ-11。该飞机也是中国发展有人与无人协作能力的更广泛努力的一部分。 J-20S 是世界上第一款两座第五代战斗机，于 2021 年首次亮相，通常被评估为此类行动的潜在机载指挥和控制平台，尽管 2025 年 11 月的镜头显示单座 J-20 也可以与 GJ-11 协调。 Çin Hava Kuvvetleri，GJ-11 hayalet taarruz ïHA’sının yakın çekim gorüntülerini yayımladı。 Görüntülerin，GJ-21 是一种电气设备，可通过视频设备进行操作。
https://t.co/imBIWOwV5h — Enis Şenol (@senolenis) 2026 年 11 月 9 日 GJ-11 最显着的特点之一是其扁平的屏蔽排气出口，集成到飞翼机身的后上部分。加上背部进气口和没有外部喷嘴，这种布置似乎是为了减少飞机的雷达和红外特征。中国军事专家宋忠平表示，排气喷嘴经过特殊处理以提高隐身性，但具体设计细节及其效果尚未透露。该飞机的配置表明低可观测性是一个主要的设计优先事项，但其实际的机动性和飞行性能仍然未知。第一张图：GJ-11 UCAV 喷嘴 第二张图：GJ-11 EOTS 和锯齿状机腹舱门。 https://t.co/NSj7vAdfeb —

【原文 English Original】
New official footage released ahead of the PLA Air Force’s 77th anniversary reveals additional details of the GJ-11’s design and configuration. China released new official footage of the GJ-11 ‘Sharp Sword’ unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) on Nov. 9, 2026, revealing additional features of its design and configuration. The release came two days before the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) on Nov. 11. On the same date last year, the PLAAF released its first footage showing the GJ-11 flying in formation with a J-20 and a J-16D Electronic Warfare (EW) aircraft. The GJ-11 is often considered to be equivalent in role to the U.S. Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA). #PLAAF GJ-11 is featured in an Air Force promotional video. https://t.co/hPS8qG5jWv — Iron Lady (@nuwangzi) November 9, 2026 New footage of the GJ-11 loyal wingman The latest visuals provide a closer look at the GJ-11’s airframe and surface finish, although the composition of its coating cannot be determined from the footage alone. Chinese military affairs expert Song Zhongping, quoted by Global Times , said the aircraft uses Radar Absorbent Material (RAM) coatings to reduce its radar cross-section. The GJ-11 appears to be a relatively high-end, stealth-focused UCAV, rather than a lower-cost, potentially attritable platform. In this respect, it could be more comparable to the type of high-capability aircraft Lockheed Martin is developing with Vectis than to the more affordability-focused CCA concepts being pursued under the U.S. Air Force’s first increment, such as the FQ-42A Vengeance and the FQ-44A Fury . The GJ-11 leaving the hangar. | Source: PLA Air Force The new footage provides a closer look at the GJ-11 than the November 2025 anniversary film, which showed the UCAV flying in formation with a J-20 and a J-16D. The existence of multiple airframes had already been indicated by satellite imagery published in October 2025, showing three GJ-11s at Shigatse Air Base in Tibet. The aircraft is also part of China’s broader effort to develop manned-unmanned teaming capabilities. The J-20S, the world’s first two-seat fifth generation fighter first revealed in 2021, is often assessed as a potential airborne command-and-control platform for such operations, although the November 2025 footage demonstrated that a single-seat J-20 could also coordinate with the GJ-11. Çin Hava Kuvvetleri, GJ-11 hayalet taarruz İHA’sının yakın çekim görüntülerini yayımladı. Görüntülerin, GJ-21 İHA’sının elektromanyetik katapultla fırlatılışını gösteren yeni bir videonun habercisi olabileceği değerlendiriliyor. https://t.co/imBIWOwV5h — Enis Şenol (@senolenis) November 9, 2026 One of the GJ-11’s most distinctive features is its flattened, shielded exhaust outlet, integrated into the upper rear section of the flying-wing airframe. Together with the dorsal air intake and the absence of external nozzles, this arrangement appears intended to reduce the aircraft’s radar and infrared signatures. Chinese military affairs expert Song Zhongping said the exhaust nozzle had received special treatment to improve stealth, although the precise details of the design and its effectiveness have not been disclosed. The aircraft’s configuration suggests that low observability was a major design priority, but its actual maneuverability and flight performance remain unknown. 1st pic: GJ-11 UCAV nozzle 2nd pic:  GJ-11 EOTS and serated belly bay doors. https://t.co/NSj7vAdfeb — dafeng cao (@dafengcao) November 9, 2026 As in the November 2025 footage, the GJ-11 is shown from several angles inside a hangar. A front-facing sequence showing the hangar doors opening and the aircraft being towed out, followed by a brief view from underneath, appears to have been reused from the earlier video. The November 2025 footage also shows a protective cover for Foreign Object Debris (FOD) fitted over the dorsal air intake, along with several red covers over other areas of the forward fuselage. In the latest visuals, showing a top view of the GJ-11 exiting the hangar, the protective covers visible in the November 2025 footage are absent. Several small diamond-shaped features can also be seen along the upper fuselage and wings, although their function is unclear. The apparent chin-mounted electro-optical sensor, glimpsed briefly in the November 2025 footage, is also visible in greater detail in the new close-up shots inside the hangar. The trapezoidal fairing visible beneath the nose appears to house an electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor. Its exact configuration and capabilities have not been publicly disclosed, and the available imagery is insufficient to establish whether it incorporates Infra-Red Search and Track (IRST) or Electro-Optical Tracking System (EOTS) functions for both air-to-air and air-to-ground roles. PLAAF成立76周年記念動画内にて公開されたGJ-11 ステルスUCAV。 部隊運用機の公式メディアでの公開はこれが初ですが、実際には数年前から部隊運用中。 動画内で有人機との協調飛行中のGJ-11に与えられたコードは”玄龙”。 なおGJ-11は派生型として海軍向け艦載機型のGJ-21が存在。 https://t.co/WBunfUg79x — お砂糖wsnbn (@sugar_wsnbn) November 11, 2025 Weapons bays and landing gear The latest footage also shows the GJ-11’s two internal weapons bays on the underside of the fuselage, positioned between the main landing gear and covered by separate sets of doors. Glo bal Times reported that the aircraft’s two belly bays were previously displayed during Airshow China 2021, “each holding several precision-guided bombs.” A brief front-facing segment shows the aircraft during its takeoff run, while side and rear views capture the landing gear retracting after liftoff. The November 2025 video also showed the GJ-11 taking off, although the landing gear remained extended in the available footage. A screengrab showing the main landing gear, a partly open internal weapons-bay door and the apparent chin-mounted electro-optical sensor. | Source: PLA Air Force One segment showing the GJ-11 inside the hangar provides another view of the main landing gear, which appears close to the outer weapons-bay door . The same shot also shows what appears to be a slightly open weapons-bay door, with its serrated edge visible. However, the available angle does not clearly establish how the landing gear folds or whether the aircraft represents a different configuration. It is therefore not possible to determine whether this is another airframe or a prototype. Another screenshot circulating on Chinese social media appears to show three additional flying-wing aircraft parked behind the GJ-11s, although their identities and configurations cannot be confirmed from the available image. Red boxes highlight what looks like GJ-11s parked behind the one featured in the video in the edited screenshot circulating online. | Source: PLA Air Force According to CCTV, the Nov. 9 coverage also revealed that the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission. The broadcaster did not disclose when or where the mission took place, the target involved or the weapon used, although the report nevertheless offers a clearest indication of the GJ-11’s strike capabilities. The new footage therefore provides more than just a closer look at the GJ-11’s low-observable design. Combined with the PLAAF’s November 2025 formation footage and the latest report of a first live-fire strike mission, it offers further evidence that the UCAV has progressed beyond the prototype and testing stages. Further details about its operational deployment, weapons and manned-unmanned teaming capabilities, however, remain undisclosed. It remains to be seen whether China will release additional footage of the GJ-11 or its naval derivative, the GJ-21 , before the end of the year.

title: Le robó más que el corazón: Los mejores memes de la infidelidad del CEO de NVIDIA con supuesta espía china
zh_title: 他偷走的不仅仅是他的心：NVIDIA 首席执行官与一名所谓的中国间谍不忠的最佳模因
summary: 但是正义大人，您唯一的罪行就是爱！ Nvidia 联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 面临的困境比安迪·拜伦 (Andy Byron) 在酷玩乐队 Kiss Cam 作弊被发现后被迫辞去天文学家首席执行官一职的困境还要大。这个情节堪比一部墨西哥肥皂剧，或者更好的是一部韩剧，以与黄仁勋的风流韵事开始，以涉嫌从中国向半导体巨头英伟达从事间谍活动的丑闻结束。就像好的商业八卦一样，模因已经完成了解释一切的工作。一切都被The New Yo的一张纸条引爆
content:
但是正义大人，您唯一的罪行就是爱！ Nvidia 联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 面临的困境比安迪·拜伦 (Andy Byron) 在酷玩乐队 Kiss Cam 作弊被发现后被迫辞去天文学家首席执行官一职的困境还要大。这个情节堪比一部墨西哥肥皂剧，或者更好的是一部韩剧，以与黄仁勋的风流韵事开始，以涉嫌从中国向半导体巨头英伟达从事间谍活动的丑闻结束。就像好的商业八卦一样，模因已经完成了解释一切的工作。一切都是由《纽约时报》的一则消息引发的。美国报纸报道称，据美国情报机构称，黄仁勋与一名来自中国的芯片买家关系密切，该买家正在为北京收集信息。这名女性名叫 Alice Huang（同姓纯属巧合），她曾是一名电视主持人，后来在与 Nvidia 有业务往来的新加坡公司 Megaspeed 担任经理。事实证明，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与涉嫌为中国情报部门工作的Megaspeed高管爱丽丝黄有染。据他说，他偷的不仅仅是她的心，因为他本可以从她那里获得战略情报。
🍿 pic.twitter.com/qIaevVpGs7 — 梅雷迪思·盖伊🛋️✨ (@MerGarza) 2026 年 11 月 9 日 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋承认对妻子不忠 与 Kristin Cabot（现为 Astronomer 前人力资源主管）的首席执行官相比，黄仁勋已经比 Astronomer 的首席执行官更陷困境，黄仁勋承认他与一位企业高管有亲密的关系。英伟达在公司网站上发表了一封信，向妻子道歉：“我对我的妻子不忠……我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”不过，他并没有明确提及黄丽娟。这种情况很快就会持续下去，因为有报道称黄仁勋是“外国情报工作的目标”，英伟达宣布进行独立调查。尽管这家人工智能巨头认为没有理由相信国家安全和公司机密面临风险：“委员会的调查将检查所有可用信息。”尽管黄仁勋已经出现在带有LinkedIn“开放工作”横幅的模因中，但英伟达表示，他将在调查期间继续领导公司。黄在信中表示：“我支持调查并将全力配合。我热爱我们的国家和我们的公司。我致力于保护 NVIDIA 并支持美国的国家安全。”
此外，中方否认为詹森设下陷阱，认为这是抹黑行为。中国外交部发言人郭家琨表示，所谓对中国从事间谍活动的指控毫无根据，无非是对中国的污蔑。在贸易紧张局势中，黄仁勋近年来一直在推动放宽对中国芯片销售的限制。当我们等待下一季首播时，这些是 Nvidia 肥皂剧留给我们的最好的模因。在这里，詹森遇到了他的机器的叛逆：许多机器都具有人工智能。那么，詹森现在是一部肥皂剧吗？这已经失控了。 😆 pic.twitter.com/nWcZ7wjx4V — Sovey (@SoveyX) 2026 年 11 月 9 日

【原文 English Original】
¡Pero Señor Justicia, su único delito fue amar! Jensen Huang, cofundador y director ejecutivo de Nvidia , está en un aprieto más grande que el que sacó a Andy Byron de su cargo como CEO de Astronomer tras ser atrapado en una infidelidad en la Kiss Cam de Coldplay. Esta trama digna de telenovela mexicana o, mejor aún, de drama coreano, comenzó con un affaire de Jensen Huang y terminó como un escándalo de presunto espionaje de China a Nvidia , gigante de los semiconductores. Como buen cotilleo empresarial, los memes ya han hecho la tarea de explicarlo todo. Todo detonó por una nota de The New York Times . El diario estadounidense publicó que, según las agencias de inteligencia estadounidenses, Jensen Huang tenía una relación estrecha con una compradora de chips originaria de China, quien estaba recopilando información para Pekín. La mujer en cuestión es Alice Huang (el mismo apellido es coincidencia), una exconductora de televisión que dio el salto como directiva a Megaspeed , empresa de Singapur que tiene negocios con Nvidia. Resulta que Jensen Huang, CEO de NVIDIA, tenía un amorío con Alice Huang, ejecutiva de Megaspeed, sospechosa de trabajar para la inteligencia china. Y según le robó más que el corazón, porque podría haberle sacado información estratégica. 🍿 pic.twitter.com/qIaevVpGs7 — Meredith Gay 🛋️✨ (@MerGarza) November 9, 2026 Jensen Huang, CEO de Nvidia, admite infidelidad a su esposa Ya más atrapado que el CEO de Astronomer con Kristin Cabot (ahora exencargada de Recursos Humanos de Astronomer), Jensen Huang admitió que tuvo una relación íntima con una ejecutiva de negocios. El CEO de Nvidia publicó una carta en el sitio web de la empresa donde se disculpaba con su esposa: “ Fui infiel a mi esposa (...) Mis acciones la han herido a ella y a nuestros hijos. No hay excusa para lo que hice. Lo siento profundamente”. Sin embargo, no mencionó explícitamente de Alice Huang . Esto tendrá una continuación pronto, pues Nvidia anunció una investigación independiente tras los reportes de que Jensen Huang era “objetivo de un esfuerzo de inteligencia extranjera”. Aunque el gigante de la inteligencia artificial consideró que no había motivos para creer que la seguridad nacional y los secretos de la empresa estén en riesgo: “La investigación del consejo examinará toda la información disponible”. Pese a que en los memes Jensen Huang ya aparece con el cintillo de “Open to work” de LinkedIn, Nvidia afirmó que continuará al frente de la empresa durante la investigación. “Apoyo la investigación y cooperaré plenamente. Amo a nuestro país y a nuestra empresa. Estoy comprometido a proteger a NVIDIA y a apoyar la seguridad nacional de Estados Unidos”, expresó Huang en su carta. Además, China negó haber tendido una trampa a Jensen y consideró que se trata de una campaña de desprestigio. “La llamada acusación de espionaje chino carece de fundamento. No son más que calumnias contra China”, afirmó Guo Jiakun, portavoz del Ministerio chino de Relaciones Exteriores. En medio de las tensiones comerciales, en los últimos años Huang presionó para hacer más flexibles las restricciones de venta de chips a China . Mientras esperamos que se estrene la siguiente temporada, estos son los mejores memes que nos dejó la telenovela de Nvidia. Y aquí Jensen se encuentra con la rebelión de sus máquinas: muchos son con inteligencia artificial. So, Jensen is a telenovela now? This has gotten out of control. 😆 pic.twitter.com/nWcZ7wjx4V — Sovey (@SoveyX) November 9, 2026 This is how Jensen lost it. pic.twitter.com/resbzR33GX — Doge Tipping (@Dogetothemoon) November 9, 2026 El único delito que ha cometido Jensen Huang es amar pic.twitter.com/e2alkAu9zC — Gon (@bellingjamonn) November 9, 2026 Finally found the true purpose of a foldable phone . Folded: Family man Jensen Huang Unfolded: What the CEO of Nvidia saw before leaking the new AI chip architecture. pic.twitter.com/8ykNbmalx8 — Salt (@saltvibe) November 9, 2026 10 hilarious Jensen memes breaking the internet, part 2 🧵👇 1 - "POV: The moment Jensen Huang and Alice got caught in 4K 😭💀" ~ By @eylboh https://t.co/22XE4RPIQd pic.twitter.com/1XgSSaZPMP — Investing visuals (@InvestingVisual) November 9, 2026 Jensen Huang sending out an apology via email pic.twitter.com/fmsSo83C1K — Dividend Hero (@HeroDividend) November 8, 2026 JENSEN HUANG IN LOVE ACTUALLY IS WILD 😭 → Shows up with handwritten signs → Admits he slept with a Chinese spy → Says he can't afford a costly divorce → Offers an RTX 5090 to save the marriage An AI-made movie parody, and the expressions make the punchline even better… pic.twitter.com/MzsDJw4BsA — Hakimi Eiqbal (@hakimieiqbal) November 9, 2026 $NVDA How Jensen was moving in China pic.twitter.com/1giJLJtplI — The Wheelie Investor (@WheelieInvestor) November 8, 2026 Con información de AP.

Fundraiser by Yangkey Gangshar : Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children
This fund brings food, housing, and school costs to Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and children
Yangkey Gangshar is organizing this fundraiser.
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.
We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.
“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.
A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family
At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.
Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.
He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.
The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.
Our Family’s Connection to This Community
Our connection to this region goes back generations.
Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.
Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.
The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.
Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.
The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.
Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.
What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.
Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.
His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.
We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.
Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.
We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.
The funds will be used specifically for:
Shelter, rent, and household expenses
School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives
100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.
Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.
We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.
Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.
If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.
Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.
From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.
Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family
“The basic foundation of humanity is compassion and love.”

Kenya: Water Rationing Looms in Nairobi As Ndakaini Dam Levels Decline - allAfrica.com
Kenya: Water Rationing Looms in Nairobi As Ndakaini Dam Levels Decline
Residents queue to buy water at a local water vendor (file photo).
Nairobi — Water rationing is set to intensify in Nairobi and neighbouring counties after declining levels at Thika/Ndakaini Dam forced a 35 per cent reduction in water production at two major treatment plants supplying the capital.
Nairobi City Water and Sewerage Company said the reduction at Ngethu and Kigoro water treatment plants took effect immediately, warning that customers should brace for extended periods without water as the utility moves to preserve the dwindling reserves.
In a notice issued on Monday, November 9, the company attributed the production cuts to below-average rainfall in the dam's catchment area, which has affected water inflows into the reservoir.
"Thika Dam, the principal source of water for Nairobi and surrounding areas, has experienced a significant decline in storage levels due to below-average rainfall within its catchment area," the company said.
Follow us on WhatsApp | LinkedIn for the latest headlines
It added that reduced inflows had necessitated a temporary reduction in water abstraction to preserve the available reserves and ensure sustainable supply over the coming months.
The company warned that the cuts would translate into longer water rationing periods for customers served by seven water utilities across Nairobi and neighbouring counties.
Besides Nairobi City Water, the affected providers are Githunguri Water and Sanitation Company, Kiambu Water and Sanitation Company, Karuri Water and Sanitation Company, Mavoko Water and Sewerage Company, Oloolaiser Water and Sewerage Company and Olkejuado Water and Sewerage Company.
The affected areas span Nairobi, Kiambu, Machakos and Kajiado counties, raising the prospect of increased pressure on households, businesses and institutions that depend on the utilities for daily water needs.
Nairobi Water said it would continue monitoring the dam's storage levels and prevailing weather conditions, with production volumes subject to periodic review depending on improvements in reservoir recovery and water inflows.
"Production volumes will be reviewed periodically based on reservoir recovery and water inflows," the company said.
The utility urged consumers to adopt water-saving measures, avoid unnecessary wastage and reserve available supplies for essential household and other critical needs.
It acknowledged that the reduction would disrupt normal supply but appealed to residents to cooperate as it manages the available resources.
"We recognise the inconvenience that the reduced water production may cause and sincerely appeal for the public's patience, understanding and cooperation as we work to sustainably manage the available water resources," the company said.

content:
继有记录以来最热的十月之后，香港人本周将经历寒流。香港人穿着夹克。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周一该市最低气温将达到 19 摄氏度，周二气温将在 16 至 23 摄氏度之间。一股强冷锋将横过中国南部沿海，为本港带来干燥凉爽的天气：“受冷锋带来的强烈东北季风影响，今天广东地区有风，气温明显下降……昼夜温差较大。”然而，随着热带气旋千帕卡抵达日本，周三之后气温将开始上升，预计周末将有阵雨：“季风预计将在本周后半段减弱，该地区气温将上升……高空扰动将在周末为中国南部带来阵雨。”有记录以来最热的十月天文台录得有史以来最高的十月平均最高气温30.5摄氏度。 2026 年夏季，香港遭遇破纪录的热浪。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
上周在一份新闻稿中表示：“主要是由于东北季风较正常弱，华南地区高空反气旋较正常强，加上气候变暖和可能持续至明年初的强烈厄尔尼诺现象，2026年10月香港异常温暖。”政府间气候变化专门委员会警告说，自20世纪50年代以来，热浪的强度和频率持续增加，原因是人为造成的气候变化。二氧化碳等温室气体的普遍存在，将热量滞留在大气中，导致地球表面温度升高，更热、更长时间的热浪将生命置于危险之中。另请参阅：极端高温如何成为世界天气灾害中最致命的无声杀手 研究非政府组织伯克利地球表示，自工业革命以来，香港的气温已经升高了 1.7 摄氏度。根据 2023 年的一项研究，到本世纪末，高温和湿度可能会在较长时间内达到致命水平，导致世界某些地区无法呆在户外。

【原文 English Original】
Hongkongers will experience a cold snap this week following the hottest October on record. People wearing jackets in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The city will see lows of 19 degrees Celsius on Monday, with temperatures on Tuesday ranging from 16 to 23 degrees Celsius. A strong cold front will cross China’s southern coast, bringing dry and cool weather to the territory: “Under the influence of the intense northeast monsoon associated with a cold front, it will be windy and temperatures will fall appreciably over Guangdong today… The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large.” However, the mercury will begin to rise after Wednesday with showers expected over the weekend as Tropical Cyclone Cempaka arrives in Japan: “The monsoon is expected to moderate in the latter part of this week, temperatures will rise over the region… Upper-air disturbances will bring showers to southern China towards the weekend.” Hottest October on record It comes after the Observatory recorded the highest-ever monthly mean maximum temperature in October of 30.5 degrees Celsius. Hong Kong saw a record-breaking heatwave in summer 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Mainly due to a weaker-than-normal northeast monsoon and a stronger-than-normal upper-air anticyclone over southern China, and set against the backdrop of climate warming and a very strong El Niño event that may persist into early next year, October 2026 was unseasonably warm in Hong Kong,” it said last week in a press release. The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change has warned that the intensity and frequency of heatwaves have continued to increase since the 1950s due to human-caused climate change. The prevalence of greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide – which trap heat in the atmosphere – raises the planet’s surface temperature, with hotter, longer heatwaves putting lives at risk. See also: How extreme heat became the deadliest silent killer among world weather disasters Hong Kong has already warmed by 1.7 degrees Celsius since the Industrial Revolution, research NGO Berkeley Earth says . Heat and humidity may reach lethal levels for protracted periods by the end of the century, according to a 2023 study , making it impossible to stay outdoors in some parts of the world.

路透社報導，約32%的美國民眾認同川普執政表現，與路透社/益普索（Reuters/Ipsos）在10月底至11月初進行的前兩次民調結果相同。這項數據僅比10月中旬路透社/益普索民調中的31%略高出1個百分點，而31%也是他政治生涯中的最低紀錄。
川普所屬的共和黨在11月3日期中選舉中遭遇慘敗，失去聯邦參眾兩院的控制權。儘管部分選舉結果尚未出爐，民主黨仍在眾議院取得至少自2008年以來最大勝利，並在傳統上由共和黨占優勢的堪薩斯州、南卡羅來納州及德州等地翻轉參議院席次。

title: QNAP Warns Users as Plex2Shell Flaws Are Used to Hack NAS Devices
zh_title: QNAP 警告用户 Plex2Shell 缺陷被用来攻击 NAS 设备
summary: 在有报道称 NAS 通过 Plex2Shell 漏洞链受到危害后，台湾供应商 QNAP 敦促用户更新 Plex Media Server。在有报告称威胁者利用 Plex2Shell 漏洞链危害 NAS 设备后，QNAP 敦促用户通过 QNAP App Center 更新 Plex Media Server。 “QNAP 已收到一些用户的报告，称其 NAS 上的 Plex Media Server 似乎已因这些漏洞而受到损害，QNAP 技术支持正在协助 QNAP 发布的受影响用户咨询。”供应商发布的报告中写道。 “威联通
content:
在有报道称 NAS 通过 Plex2Shell 漏洞链受到危害后，台湾供应商 QNAP 敦促用户更新 Plex Media Server。在有报告称威胁者利用 Plex2Shell 漏洞链危害 NAS 设备后，QNAP 敦促用户通过 QNAP App Center 更新 Plex Media Server。 “QNAP 已收到一些用户的报告，称其 NAS 上的 Plex Media Server 似乎已因这些漏洞而受到损害，QNAP 技术支持正在协助 QNAP 发布的受影响用户咨询。”供应商发布的报告中写道。 “QNAP 产品安全事件响应团队 (QNAP PSIRT) 已确认该漏洞仅存在于 Plex Media Server 中；QTS、QuTS Hero 和其他 QNAP 操作系统本身不受影响。” Plex Media Server 旨在使电影、音乐和其他媒体可以跨设备使用。但是，当服务器暴露在互联网上并运行易受攻击的软件时，它可能会成为对您的电影收藏不感兴趣的攻击者的切入点。 2026 年 10 月 16 日，安全研究员 Zach Main 发布了名为 Plex2Shell 的漏洞链的技术细节和概念验证 (PoC) 代码。一天之内，研究人员就观察到攻击者利用该漏洞攻击面向互联网的蜜罐，部署加密货币挖掘恶意软件和代理软件。这一事件提醒我们，威胁行为者可以以多么快的速度将公共漏洞武器化。
该链结合了 Plex Media Server 中的四个漏洞：CVE-2026-96652、CVE-2026-96654、CVE-2026-96655 和 CVE-2026-96656。只要满足所需条件，它们就可以允许攻击者在没有有效凭据的情况下在易受攻击的服务器上执行任意代码。该代码以 Plex 服务的权限运行，使攻击者有机会安装额外的软件并滥用主机。技术细节可在 Main 的原始分析 Plex2Shell 中找到。 Plex 于 7 月 27 日收到有关这些漏洞的通知，并于 8 月 4 日承认了该报告，并授予了漏洞赏金。该公司于 9 月份在漏洞代码公开之前发布了修复程序。加载程序不会检查库的名称、可执行权限、数字签名或符号。因此，该库的 ELF 构造函数可以使用与 Plex 服务相同的权限运行。 “它不检查 lib 前缀，不需要执行位，不验证任何签名，也不查找任何特定符号。”阅读 zmain.com 发布的报告。 “当 dlopen 加载共享对象时，它会在执行任何符号解析之前运行 ELF 的 DT_INIT_ARRAY（构造函数）。仅具有构造函数且没有导出符号的 .so 仍将在加载时执行其代码。然后我们触发第二次转码。
编解码器目录被重新枚举，我们在第 4 阶段编写的 .so 被加载，并且构造函数以 uid=1000(plex) 运行。”这个细节很重要，因为最后阶段可以利用 Plex 加载共享库的方式。该链使用与转码相关的设置来影响执行，允许特制的库在 Plex 加载时运行。结果可以是在服务帐户下执行代码，而不需要攻击者首先获得交互式登录。 QNAP 敦促用户立即更新 Plex Media Server，用户应前往 App Center，打开我的应用程序并将 Plex Media Server 更新到版本 1.43.3 或更高版本。然后他们应该检查 Plex Web，并

【原文 English Original】
Taiwanese vendor QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server after reports of NAS compromises through the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain. QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server through the QNAP App Center after reports that threat actors exploited the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain to compromise NAS devices. “QNAP has received reports from some users that Plex Media Server on their NAS appears to have been compromised through these vulnerabilities, and QNAP Technical Support is assisting the affected usersadvisory published by QNAP. ” reads the report published by the vendor. “The QNAP Product Security Incident Response Team (QNAP PSIRT) has confirmed that the vulnerabilities exist only in Plex Media Server; QTS, QuTS hero, and other QNAP operating systems are not themselves affected.” Plex Media Server is designed to make movies, music, and other media available across devices. But when a server is exposed to the internet and runs vulnerable software, it can become an entry point for attackers who have little interest in your film collection. On October 16, 2026, security researcher Zach Main published technical details and proof-of-concept (PoC) code for a vulnerability chain dubbed Plex2Shell. Within a day, researchers had observed attackers using the exploit against an internet-facing honeypot, deploying cryptocurrency-mining malware and proxy software. The incident is a reminder of how quickly a public exploit can be weaponized by threat actors. The chain combines four vulnerabilities in Plex Media Server: CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656. Together, they can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable servers without valid credentials, provided the required conditions are met. The code runs with the privileges of the Plex service, giving attackers an opportunity to install additional software and abuse the host. The technical details are available in Main’s original analysis, Plex2Shell . Plex had been notified of the vulnerabilities on July 27 and acknowledged the report on August 4, awarding a bug bounty. The company released fixes in September, before the exploit code became public. The loader does not check the library’s name, executable permissions, digital signature, or symbols. As a result, the library’s ELF constructor can run with the same privileges as the Plex service. “It doesn’t check for a lib prefix, doesn’t require the execute bit, doesn’t verify any signature, and doesn’t look for any specific symbol.” reads the report published by zmain.com. “When dlopen loads a shared object, it runs the ELF’s DT_INIT_ARRAY (constructor functions) before doing any symbol resolution. A .so that only has a constructor and no exported symbols will still execute its code on load. We then trigger a second transcode. The codec directory gets re-enumerated, the .so we wrote in Stage 4 gets loaded, and the constructor runs as uid=1000(plex) .” That detail matters because the final stage can exploit how Plex loads shared libraries. The chain uses a setting related to transcoding to influence execution, allowing a specially crafted library to run when Plex loads it. The result can be code execution under the service account, without requiring the attacker to obtain an interactive login first. QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server immediately, users should go to App Center, open My Apps and update Plex Media Server to version 1.43.3 or later. They should then check in Plex Web, under Settings and General, that the installed version is 1.43.3.10861 or later. QNAP will release further updates after verifying them, but users should not wait. If Plex was reachable from the internet while running version 1.43.2 or earlier, users should treat the NAS as potentially compromised. This may apply if Plex Remote Access was enabled, port 32400 was forwarded, or the port was opened automatically through UPnP or router settings. Updating alone will not remove anything an attacker may have installed. In those cases, users should follow QNAP’s FAQ to perform a clean reinstall, check for signs of compromise and reset both their Plex and NAS credentials. The company also advises disabling Plex Remote Access if it is not needed and avoiding port forwarding for port 32400. Users who need remote access should use a VPN instead. QNAP also recommends keeping QTS or QuTS hero and all installed apps up to date. Step-by-step instructions are available in the Plex2Shell: Check and Remediation FAQ for QNAP NAS Users . CISA added Plex2Shell flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 20, 2026, urging federal agencies to addresse them by October 23, 2026. Lu You-chen poses with his accolades after winning seven gold medals at the 2026 Asian Sport Stacking Championships in Thailand. Photo courtesy of World Sport Stacking Association Taiwan
Taipei, Nov. 9 (CNA) Team Taiwan won 48 gold, 21 silver and 22 bronze medals at the 2026 Asian Sport Stacking Championships, held in Thailand from Nov. 6-8.
Lu You-chen (呂侑宸), 12, won seven gold medals, becoming the first Taiwanese male competitor to claim the overall all-around title at the championships.
Lu recorded a combined time of 9.254 seconds in the 3-3-3, 3-6-3 and Cycle events.
He also won gold in the individual Cycle event in his age category, recording a time of 5.542 seconds, breaking the previous Taiwanese record of 5.601 seconds for boys aged 11-12.
Lu's mother was present when a representative of the Thai royal family presented him with the all-around male trophy. She said the achievement was both an honor and recognition of her son's efforts.
Meanwhile, 9-year-old Lin Shih-chi (林詩淇) won seven medals, including gold in all four individual events in her age group: 3-3-3, 3-6-3, Cycle and all-around.
Lin also took bronze in the all-around female category across all age groups.
She said she hoped her mother would reward her performance by buying her more stuffed toys.
Another standout was 8-year-old Fan Chen-yuan (范宸媛), who won gold in the girls' 7-8 age group Cycle event, setting a world record of 5.840 seconds and breaking her previous record of 6.055 seconds.
Taiwan sent 71 competitors to this year's championships, which drew 536 athletes from 11 countries and regions.

title: Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang. But its board may have no interest in challenging its leader
zh_title: 英伟达正在调查黄仁勋。但其董事会可能没有兴趣挑战其领导人
summary: 尽管英伟达已经对有关中国情报部门针对首席执行官黄仁勋以及黄仁勋与一名所谓的中国间谍有染的爆炸性报道展开了独立调查，但早期迹象表明该公司董事会可能不愿意或无法挑战这位摇滚明星首席执行官。 10 月 29 日，当《纽约时报》首次报道美国情报部门对黄与新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 的接触感到担忧时，该公司将这种关系描述为普通商业问题，并表示不属于同一类别。
content:
尽管英伟达已经对有关中国情报部门针对首席执行官黄仁勋以及黄仁勋与一名所谓的中国间谍有染的爆炸性报道展开了独立调查，但早期迹象表明该公司董事会可能不愿意或无法挑战这位摇滚明星首席执行官。 10 月 29 日，当《纽约时报》首次报道美国情报部门对黄与新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 的接触感到担忧时，该公司将这种关系描述为普通商业问题，并表示不会与客户分享机密信息。直到 10 天后，黄仁勋在给员工的一份备忘录中承认了这一事件，并强调“没有理由相信国家安全或 NVIDIA 机密遭到泄露”后，董事会才宣布展开调查。在调查开始之前，董事会就已经表示“对詹森和他的领导团队充满信心”。该公告还将调查的重点放在国家安全上，但没有提及是否会解决对黄的判断或作为高管的行为的潜在担忧。英伟达表示，黄仁勋将继续担任首席执行官，不会间断。 Fast Company 联系了 Nvidia 请其置评，但截至发稿时尚未收到回复。
事实上，英伟达董事会可能无法在不严重危及公司业务的情况下惩罚黄仁勋，因为公司业务已经与黄仁勋本人密不可分。黄仁勋于 1993 年与他人共同创立了英伟达，并花了三十多年的时间将其从一家图形芯片制造商转变为人工智能热潮中的主导力量。这位 63 岁的老人几乎参与了公司业务的各个方面——从产品开发到与客户和政府官员的关系——有 60 多名高管直接向他汇报。这种依赖性可能会使董事会的任务变得特别困难。英伟达尚未公开确定黄仁勋的继任者，分析师警告称，他的离职可能会给该公司带来巨大的不确定性。 Yorkville Ives & Co 合伙人兼高级董事总经理丹·艾夫斯 (Dan Ives) 写道：“詹森是不可替代的。管理团队中没有其他人可以无缝地担任首席执行官。”一个组织把所有的鸡蛋都放在领导者的篮子里可能是有风险的，而且不仅仅是在商业上。在政治方面，共和党在上周的蓝色海啸之后经历了惨痛的教训——在将自己打造为唐纳德·特朗普的政党之后，共和党领导人开始慢慢与总统保持距离，因为民主党历史性的大胜暴露了MAGA运动的裂痕。截至中午 12 点 50 分，英伟达股价下跌近 5%。美国东部时间。

【原文 English Original】
While Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into bombshell reports that Chinese intelligence targeted CEO Jensen Huang—and that Huang had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy —early indications suggest that the company’s board may be unwilling or unable to challenge the rockstar CEO. On October 29, when The New York Times first reported that US intelligence had concerns about Huang’s contacts with Alice Huang, a former top executive at Singapore-based data center firm Megaspeed, the company characterized the relationship as an ordinary business matter and said it didn’t share classified information with customers. The board did not announce an investigation until 10 days later, after Huang acknowledged the affair in a memo to staff, emphasizing that it “has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised.” And before the investigation even started, the board had already said it had “confidence in Jensen and his leadership team.” The announcement also framed the investigation as focused on national security, without mentioning whether it would address potential concerns about Huang’s judgment or conduct as an executive. Nvidia has said Huang will continue serving as CEO without interruption. Fast Company reached out to Nvidia for comment but had not received a response by the time of publication. Indeed, there may be little Nvidia’s board can do to punish Huang without seriously risking the company’s business, which has become inextricable from Huang himself. Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and has spent more than three decades transforming it from a maker of graphics chips into a dominant force in the artificial intelligence boom. The 63-year-old is involved in nearly every aspect of the company’s business—from product development to its relationships with customers and government officials—with more than 60 executives reporting directly to him . That dependence could make the board’s task particularly difficult. Nvidia has no publicly identified successor to Huang, and analysts have warned that his departure could create enormous uncertainty for the company. “Jensen is not replaceable,” wrote Dan Ives, partner and senior managing director at Yorkville Ives & Co. “There is no other person on the management team bench that can step in seamlessly as CEO.” An organization putting all its eggs in the basket of its leader can be risky, and not just in business. In politics, the Republican party learned that the hard way following last week’s blue tsunami —after fashioning itself the party of Donald Trump, GOP leaders are beginning to slowly distance themselves from the president, as the Democrats’ historic blow-out win lays bare the fractures in the MAGA movement.  Nvidia’s stock was down nearly 5% as of 12:50 p.m. EST.

summary: Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser. The Contemporary Uyghur An
content:
Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology
This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth
Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser.
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.
<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>
We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.
All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.
Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.
There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.
To sum up, the issues were:
No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature
So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.
<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>
"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience.
By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."
We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.
Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.
Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:
"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."
Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>
Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.
Supporting the editors - all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
Supporting our contributors - we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
Recruiting more people - paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
Enhance our level of expertise - we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
Expand our network - we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.
<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>
Munawwar Abdulla is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.
Sonya Imin is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.
Maidina Kadeer is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

近期台灣各產業資安攻擊事件頻傳，趨勢科技台灣暨香港區總經理洪偉淦指出，AI已徹底改變攻擊規則，駭客不再僅針對大型企業做精準攻擊，而是運用更低成本AI工具發動大規模、無差別的自動化入侵，企業不僅要加強風險管理，也要主動且持續檢視系統漏洞並補強。
經濟日報將於11月25日舉辦2026創新論壇，以「AI進化企業競爭力」為主題。本論壇由經濟日報、遠傳電信主辦，長榮集團、凱基金控、元大投信協辦。
洪偉淦於論壇當天將以「誰來抓AI駭客」為題進行專題演講。他認為，資安事件可看幾個層面，在攻擊手法上，駭客廣泛運用AI製作高客製化的社交工程釣魚郵件，點擊率從過去的12%大幅攀升至54%。
在入侵方式上，駭客流程亦高度自動化，以往需耗費數十小時的弱點掃描與攻擊腳本撰寫，如今在AI輔助下僅需數分鐘即可完成。比起以往，駭客更有能力廣泛找尋系統漏洞，以AI化的工具進行攻擊。
在攻擊手法上，現在利用AI技術衍生出多種攻擊手法，例如透過「提示詞注入（Prompt Injection）」繞過模型防護限制、惡意汙染開源套件供應鏈，以及藉由深偽技術（Deepfake）偽冒身分等新型態手段層出不窮，甚至有駭客集團直接將攻擊流程串接開源模型，打造全自動攻擊代理人（Attack Agent）。
他引述國際開源社群OWASP的調查，「提示詞注入」連續兩年都是風險最高的項目。面對AI武器化趨勢，他強調，防護策略必須全面升級。首先，傳統「定期掃描、嚴重漏洞優先修補」的模式已無法應對，不能再等三個月、半年掃描漏洞，企業應改採「持續性主動監控」，並依據漏洞暴露程度與實際業務影響進行動態風險排序。
另外，企業內部的AI Agent就是「數位員工」，應落實最小權限原則、獨立帳號追蹤、操作日誌留存及緊急阻斷機制，尤其涉及金流、資料傳輸等不可逆的高風險動作，必須堅持「人員介入確認（Human-in-the-loop）」。防守方（企業）也要時常透過紅藍隊攻防演練主動修補弱點，搶在駭客之前阻斷威脅。
本論壇即日起受理報名，請上官網https://money.udn.com/ACT/2026/innovation5G/index.html。
近期台灣各產業資安攻擊事件頻傳，趨勢科技台灣暨香港區總經理洪偉淦指出，AI已徹底改變攻擊規則，駭客不再僅針對大型企業做精準攻擊，而是運用更低成本AI工具發動大規模、無差別的自動化入侵，企業不僅要加強風險管理，也要主動且持續檢視系統漏洞並補強。
2026年已經進入最後兩個月，多數企業在這個時間點，應該開始規劃新年度的營運計畫，但在寫年度營運計畫之前，還有個很重要的工作，就是先盤點今年的狀況，再去規劃明年的發展，否則很容易會變成是一個喊口號但達不到的計畫書。
周末，姪兒夫婦帶著孩子，邀我們一起到河濱公園走走。幾個孩子正在草地上奔跑，天空剛好飛過一架飛機。七、八歲的姪孫抬起頭，好奇地問爸爸：「飛機那麼重，為什麼會飛？為什麼不會掉下來？」
台灣憑藉半導體與AI產業蓬勃發展，經濟屢創新高，一片欣欣向榮。然而，走進街頭巷尾，餐廳店門口掛著「誠徵正職」、飯店因缺工限縮住房率的現象卻層出不窮。國家變有錢了，內需服務業卻陷入前所未有的「缺工海嘯」。這背後除了少子化，更關鍵的原因在於科技業磁吸所產生的「人才擠出效應」。

content:
《神所是系列》第二篇：神就是光 – 罗兰岗召会 Church In Rowland Heights
亲爱的弟兄姊妹，圣经启示神的所是，有两个最基本的宣告：神就是爱，神就是光。爱说出神的性情，光说出神的彰显。光就是神自己临到人、照亮人；没有光，人就在黑暗里，不认识神，也不认识自己。我们认识神是光，就摸着了神圣洁、透亮、无可隐藏的所是，也摸着了我们蒙光照、得变化的路。
约翰一书一章五节，使徒约翰把他从主所听见的信息报给我们：“神就是光，在祂里面毫无黑暗；这是我们从祂所听见，现在又报给你们的信息。”圣经不是说神有光，像灯有光；乃是说神就是光。光不是神的一种作为，乃是神自己的所是。所以在祂里面毫无黑暗：没有一点隐藏，没有一点混杂，没有一点罪恶的成分。
圣经的第一句话就与光有关，创世记一章三节说：“神说，要有光，就有了光。”神工作的第一步就是光。地是空虚混沌、渊面黑暗，神一说话，光就来了。照样，我们这个人里面原是黑暗的，神救恩工作的第一步，也是把光带进来：光一照，混沌就退去，分别就出现，生命就开始长大。
神是光，这光不是停留在天上，乃是在基督里来到人间。约翰福音一章四节说：“生命在祂里面，这生命就是人的光。”光与生命是同一件事：祂的生命临到我们，里面就亮了；祂的光照亮我们，我们就得着生命。一章九节又说：“那光是真光，来到世上，要照亮每一个人。”世上有许多假光——知识的光、道德的光、宗教的光，照得见外面，照不进里面；惟有基督是真光，照亮每一个人，照到人心的深处。
主耶稣在八章十二节亲口宣告：“于是耶稣又对众人讲论说，我是世界的光，跟从我的，就绝不在黑暗里行，必要得着生命的光。”（祂不只照亮我们，祂更要我们跟从祂：跟从光的人，脚步就不在黑暗里，里面且得着生命的光——这光不是外面的指引，乃是内住的生命，天天在我们里面发亮，领我们往前。
认识神是光，不是为着惧怕，乃是为着交通。约翰一书一章七节说：“但我们若在光中行，如同神在光中，就彼此有交通，祂儿子耶稣的血也洗净我们一切的罪。”光有一个特点：它暴露。光照之下，我们里面的骄傲、虚假、肉体、天然，都显露出来。但感谢主，光暴露不是为着定罪，乃是为着洗净：光每暴露一样，宝血就洗净一样；我们每在光中认一样罪，与神、与弟兄姊妹的交通就恢复一分。许多基督徒怕光，喜欢躲在黑暗里保留自己，结果交通断了，里面枯干了。亲爱的弟兄姊妹，不要怕光！光就是神自己，来到光中就是来到神面前；越让祂照，就越洁净、越透明、越能与众圣徒有真实的交通。
诗篇三十六篇九节说得何等甘甜：“因为在你那里，有生命的源头；在你的光中，我们必得见光。”只有在祂的光中，我们才能看见什么是光：看见自己的本相，也看见基督的宝贵；看见道路，也看见终点。
神是光，祂的光进到我们里面，就要把我们也构成光。以弗所书五章八节说：“你们从前是黑暗，但如今在主里面乃是光，行事为人就要像光的儿女，”注意，圣经不只说我们从前在黑暗里，乃说我们从前就是黑暗；如今也不只得着光，乃在主里面成为光！这光要从我们身上活出来：说话诚实透明，行事光明磊落，不与黑暗妥协，并把这光带给身边的人——照亮家人、同事、福音朋友，使他们也来就这真光。这样活在光中的人，要带进那座全然是光的城。
启示录二十一章二十三节说：“那城内不需要日月光照，因有神的荣耀光照，又有羔羊为城的灯。”二十二章五节说得更完全：“不再有黑夜，他们也不需要灯光日光，因为主神要光照他们；他们要作王，直到永永远远。”
新耶路撒冷里不再有黑夜，因为神就是光在城中完全得着彰显，羔羊是城的灯，全体圣徒都在光中与神一同作王。我们今天每一次来到光中、每一次在光中行，就是在预尝那城的光景，也是在预备那城的来临。
我们要一同宣告：神就是光，在祂里面毫无黑暗！基督是真光，是世界的光，跟从祂的绝不在黑暗里行！我们要在光中行，彼此有交通，让宝血洗净我们一切的罪，成为光的儿女，直到新耶路撒冷不再有黑夜，神亲自光照我们，直到永永远远！
亲爱的弟兄姊妹，让我们一同祷告：主耶稣，我们感谢你，神就是光，你就是这光来到我们中间。求你天天用你的光照亮我们，暴露我们里面一切的黑暗，也用你的宝血洗净我们一切的罪；叫我们不在黑暗里行，乃在光中与你、与众圣徒有交通，成为透明发光的人，照亮我们身边的人，并预备我们进入那不再有黑夜的新耶路撒冷，在你的光中与你一同作王，直到永永远远。阿们，哈利路亚！
我虽然行过死荫的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因为你与我同在；你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席；你用油膏了我的头，使我的福杯满溢。
我一生一世必有恩惠慈爱随着我，我且要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits affair with possible Chinese asset
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与可能的中国资产有染
summary: 英伟达董事会已对其首席执行官黄仁勋展开调查，此前黄仁勋承认了婚外情，并指控他与美国当局认为可能是中国间谍的一名女性有过恋爱关系。这家人工智能硬件巨头的董事会于周日下午发表了一份声明，表示“根据最近有关创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报工作目标的报道，正在启动独立调查”。 《纽约时报》是该报道的来源。 10月29日，据称美国政府情报机构决定调查一名女性
content:
英伟达董事会已对其首席执行官黄仁勋展开调查，此前黄仁勋承认了婚外情，并指控他与美国当局认为可能是中国间谍的一名女性有过恋爱关系。这家人工智能硬件巨头的董事会于周日下午发表了一份声明，表示“根据最近有关创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报工作目标的报道，正在启动独立调查”。 《纽约时报》是该报道的来源。 10 月 29 日，据称美国政府情报机构决定调查一名名叫 Alice Huang 和/或 Huang Le 的女性，理由是她向北京传递情报。在那篇报道中，《泰晤士报》用“密切关系”一词来形容这位英伟达首席执行官与黄女士和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的关系。周日，该报称美国当局认为爱丽丝·黄和黄仁勋有着“浪漫”的关系。 《泰晤士报》还称，黄女士是一名中国公民，曾在一家名为 Megaspeed 的新加坡公司工作，该公司购买了大量 Nvidia 硬件，并怀疑这样做是为了向中国用户提供这些硬件，要么通过在数据中心内运行，要么甚至可能为到中国的运输提供便利。美国多年来一直禁止或限制向中国出口先进 GPU，部分原因是它认为北京武装部队可以使用它们来构建削弱美国军事优势的系统。
因此，黄仁勋和中国情报人员之间的任何形式的关系都将引起极大关注。该公司告诉《纽约时报》，黄仁勋和爱丽丝黄只是进行了正常的首席执行官与客户高管的聊天，这不会对英伟达的知识产权或美国国家安全构成威胁。英伟达董事会发表声明后不久，黄仁勋向员工发送了一封电子邮件，该电子邮件被公司公开。 “我欠我的家人和你们所有人一个道歉，”电子邮件开头。 “我对我的妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”黄的电子邮件没有明确将他的行为与《纽约时报》的报道联系起来，但他表示，他支持英伟达董事会展开调查的决定，“并将全力配合”。他写道：“致我在 NVIDIA 的同事，包括那些与我共事数十年的同事，以及我们的董事会、合作伙伴和世界各地的股东：你们应该从我这里得到更好的。”但他没有具体说明这是否是指不忠。 “领导 NVIDIA 是我一生的荣幸。我的责任是为您服务并值得您的信任。我没有履行这一责任。我完全致力于 NVIDIA，并将努力赢回您的信任。” “我爱我们的国家和我们的公司，”首席执行官补充道。 “我致力于保护 NVIDIA 并支持美国的国家安全。
作为一名美国人，我感到自豪和感激。”首席执行官的邮件和董事会的声明均未指控与黄女士有任何“密切关系”。因此，这种关系的确切性质仍然是个谜，Nvidia 与新加坡的关系也是如此。新加坡是一个小岛国，有时是该公司 22% 收入的来源。新加坡根本无法容纳如此多的 Nvidia 套件，因为其政府将数据中心的能源消耗限制在 1.6 吉瓦。当被要求解释这一奇怪现象时，英伟达表示它对新加坡实体感到满意

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia’s board has opened an investigation into its CEO Jensen Huang after he admitted to an affair, amid allegations he had a romantic relationship with a woman US authorities feel is likely a Chinese spy. The AI hardware giant’s board published a statement on Sunday afternoon that states it is “initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.” The New York Times is the source of that reporting . On October 29 it alleged US government intelligence agencies decided to investigate a woman who goes by Alice Huang and/or Huang Le, on grounds she passes intelligence with Beijing. In that story The Times used the term “close relationship” to describe the Nvidia CEO's associations with both Ms Huang and US president Donald Trump. On Sunday the newspaper alleged US authorities believe Alice Huang and Jensen Huang shared a "romantic" relationship. The Times further alleges Ms Huang is a Chinese citizen who worked for a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed that has bought plenty of Nvidia hardware and is suspected of doing so to make it available to Chinese users, either by running inside datacenters or perhaps even facilitating transport to the Middle Kingdom. The US has for years banned or restricted exports of advanced GPUs to China, partly because it feels Beijing’s armed forces can use them to build systems that will erode America’s military superiority. Any relationship, of any sort, between Jensen Huang and a Chinese intelligence operative would therefore be enormously concerning. The company told the NYT that Jensen Huang and Alice Huang just had normal CEO-to-customer-exec chats that were no threat to Nvidia intellectual property or US national security. Shortly after Nvidia’s board published its statement, Huang sent an email to staff that the company made public . “I owe my family and all of you an apology,” the email opens. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” Huang’s email doesn’t explicitly link his actions to The Times’ reports, but he says he supports the Nvidia board’s decision to open its investigation “and will cooperate fully.” "To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me," he wrote, without specifying if that's a reference to infidelity. "Leading NVIDIA is the privilege of my life. My responsibility is to serve you and be worthy of your trust. I have fallen short of that responsibility. I am fully committed to NVIDIA and will work to earn back your confidence." “I love our country and our company,” the CEO added. “I am committed to protecting NVIDIA and supporting America’s national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American.” The CEO’s mail, and the board’s statement, make no allegations about any “close relationship” with Ms. Huang. The exact nature of that relationship therefore remains mysterious, as does Nvidia’s relationship with Singapore, a tiny island nation that has sometimes been the source of 22 percent of the company’s revenue. Singapore is simply incapable of hosting as much Nvidia kit as that volume of purchases would buy, because its government limits datacenters to 1.6 GW of energy consumption. When asked to explain that oddity, Nvidia has said that it’s satisfied Singaporean entities buy its hardware on behalf of end-users in other locations, and that such deals are not used to evade the USA’s sanctions. Nvidia is not a notably scandal-prone company, but in 2022 it did admit to having previously misrepresented the impact of cryptocurrency mining on sales of its gaming hardware. China has opened an antitrust case , and US authorities may have considered doing likewise . Jensen Huang, however, has never presented as the kind of CEO who makes operating at the edge of the law a regular tactic. Nor does he hold sufficient Nvidia shares or voting power to unilaterally make major decisions. This leaves the leader of the world’s top AI company appearing to have made a very human error. ®

content:
微短剧：为何愈来愈多英国人观看源自中国的“碎片化”剧集？ - BBC News 中文
图像加注文字，Spare Arrow 今年稍早在社交媒体上推出了首部微短剧《Glen's Boutique》，这是一部喜剧冒险作品。
Author, 格蕾丝·迪恩（Grace Dean）
每天晚上，希瑟·夏罗克（Heather Sharrock）都会坐下来观看自己最喜爱的剧集。
但那不是在网飞（Netflix）、BBC iPlayer，甚至不是在电视上播放，而是在她的手机里。
我们之中有些人或许每晚能看完几集最新追看的剧集，Heather 却能一口气追看几十集，因为这位来自苏格兰、55岁的女子迷上了微短剧（microdrama）。
Heather 说：“现在世界上有太多乱七八糟的事情在发生，能够暂时放空，不去想那些事情，感觉很好。”
微短剧在中国早已大受欢迎，如今在英国也愈来愈流行，可在 ReelShort、CandyJar 和 DramaBox 等应用程式上观看。上星期，制作方宣布将经典肥皂剧《家有芳邻》（Neighbours）的故事线重新剪辑成超短的直式剧集，这是这种形式正逐步走向主流的最新迹象之一。
微短剧由节奏明快、张力十足的短篇集数组成，每集通常长60至90秒。许多作品聚焦于禁忌之恋、家族纷争和隐藏身份的亿万富豪等主题，而几乎每一集都会以戏剧性的悬念作结。每部作品通常有50集或以上，因此总时长与一部长篇电影相若。
来自苏格兰、45岁的影迷黛安·艾特肯（Diane Aitken）将她喜爱的狼人与吸血鬼题材微短剧形容为1980年代美国肥皂剧《家族风云》（Dallas；《朱门恩怨》／《豪门恩怨》）或《王朝》（Dynasty；《朝代》／《锦绣豪门》）的“加强版”。
图像加注文字，Diane 和 Sarah-Jayne 都表示，她们是在社交媒体上看到广告后开始接触微短剧的。
出生于中国的电影制作人孙慧明（Samantha Sun）表示，这类剧集于2010年代末在中国出现，最初是由网络小说改编而成，制作成本低廉且拍摄快捷；对许多观众而言，它们是一种逃避现实的方式。
来自唐卡斯特、46岁的莎拉—简·伦恩（Sarah-Jayne Lunn）表示，微短剧帮助她度过人生中的艰难时期。她说：“我立刻就上瘾了。我不用想太多。”
珍·库珀（Jen Cooper）是微短剧观众，现时则担任业界顾问。她对此表示认同。她说，微短剧最初主要受到寻找爱情题材内容的中年女性欢迎，许多 BookTok 和浪漫奇幻（romantasy）爱好者都会观看，但如今已吸引更广泛的观众群。
图像加注文字，中国观众已被微短剧戏剧性的情节和快节奏的特点深深吸引。
根据中国国家广播电视总局数据，去年中国微短剧市场规模超过1000亿元人民币（138.9亿美元；4200亿元新台币），观众人数突破8亿。但微短剧在韩国（南韩）、印度和美国同样受欢迎，而亚马逊 Prime、Peacock 和 Disney+ 等串流平台都已宣布计划在服务中加入微短剧。
在英国，自称全国首个专门微短剧应用程式的 TattleTV 于今年稍早推出；而皇家电视学会（Royal Television Society, RTS）则于今夏举办有关微短剧的业界座谈会。
各家公司亦希望把握微短剧热潮，为社交媒体制作品牌短片广告，其中包括杰米·奥利弗（Jamie Oliver）、合作社（Co-op），以及第四频道电视台（Channel 4）与 Sol de Janeiro 合作推出的作品。
威尔士制作公司 Spare Arrow 的夏洛特·布罗肯布罗（Charlotte Brokenbrow）表示，微短剧必须节奏明快，才能留住观众注意力。该公司于今年制作首部微短剧系列。
她说：“如果剧本和影片留白太多，观众就会觉得无聊，然后滑走。”
除了节奏飞快之外，微短剧受欢迎的原因之一是观众可以利用零碎时间观看，因此有分析人士形容它们为“零食式内容”（snackable；碎片化内容）。
安格利亚鲁斯金大学（Anglia Ruskin University, ARU）电影与媒体副教授蒂娜·肯德尔博士（Dr Tina Kendall）表示，微短剧亦迎合了观众转向“随意、低投入、可以随时开始和停止观看”的趋势。
有受访者向BBC表示，他们会在接孩子放学时于车内观看；也有人表示，会一边处理家务或行政工作，一边把微短剧当作背景播放。
Sarah-Jayne 说，由于剧情走向通常“太容易预料”，她甚至可以一边工作一边看。
专门的微短剧应用程式通常先让用户免费观看头几集，之后则要求付费订阅。CandyJar 年费49英镑（66美元；475元人民币；1960元新台币），DramaBox 则收费110英镑。不过，大部分微短剧平台都允许追剧观众购买按周计算的订阅服务，或透过观看广告换取免费集数。
当你浏览这些应用程式时，黑帮头目、欢喜冤家变情人，以及牛仔等主题一再出现。
孙慧明表示，中国制作公司经常复制成功公式，只作微小改动，而 Heather 对此亦深有同感。
她说：“很多其实都是同一个故事，只是换了不同背景设定。”又说自己已经“看腻了”亿万富豪行政总裁题材。
较为离奇的剧名包括《我领养了被偷走的孩子》（I Adopted My Stolen Baby）、《迷恋我的英国牛仔》（Craving My British Cowboy），以及《我在圣诞节找到一位无家可归的亿万富翁丈夫》（Found a Homeless Billionaire Husband for Christmas）。
一些观众表示，部分剧情有贬低女性之嫌，其中某些作品粗糙地描绘暴力和性侵情节。曾于2024年出演首部微短剧的演员可可·泰勒（Coco Taylor）说：“这甚至变成了一个笑话，女演员在吃午饭之前就已经遭遇了无数可怕的事情，哭喊了上千万次。”
泰勒表示，她曾拒绝接演某些作品，因为她认为那些剧集过于厌女。不过，她与许多微短剧爱好者都表示，故事质素已经有所提升，他们认为这是因为现在有更多剧情由美国和英国团队编写；他们亦热切谈论微短剧正逐步拓展至喜剧、惊悚和恐怖等类型。
图像加注文字，Coco Taylor 正在主演一部由威尔士制作公司拍摄的谋杀悬疑微短剧。
制作公司 Black Swan 创办人海顿·韦克林（Haydn Wakeling）于今年稍早透过电影业界人士首次听闻微短剧。他说：“快转到现在，已经变成所有人都在谈论的话题。”
韦克林表示，从财务角度来看，微短剧对导演与制作人非常有吸引力。拍摄一部时长介乎60至90分钟的微短剧通常不足两星期，因此能有效降低成本。
导演丹·勒文斯坦Dan Löwenstein）于2024年2月执导首部微短剧《黑帮情人》（Mafia Lover），如今他已拍摄到第38部。他最初参与的是由中国应用程式平台委托制作的作品，但表示随着中国业界转向人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI；人工智慧）制作，他现正与美国平台、全球串流媒体和英国公司合作。
图像加注文字，制作公司 Black Swan 的电影制作人正在为他们首部微短剧进行最后修饰。这部作品是一套于7月拍摄、共50集的谋杀悬疑剧。
英国现已成为欧洲最大的微短剧观众市场。虽然许多观众与业界制作人都对这种形式的未来感到兴奋，但它亦不乏批评者。
有人讥讽微短剧是低质内容，会破坏人们的专注力。《卫报》（The Guardian）一篇评论文章的作者便形容这类剧集“愚蠢得近乎灾难性，而且客观而言品质低劣”。
但正如由观众转型成顾问的珍·库珀所说：“没有人会说这是甚么深刻作品，但如果它能让人产生情感共鸣、令某人展露笑容，或让艰难的一天变得稍微容易一些，那肯定是一件值得庆祝的美好事情。”
